title: Do Not Email List: No National One, but Michigan and Utah
meta_description: There is no national US do not email list: the FTC advised Congress against one in 2004. Michigan and Utah run child registries; Spain’s list covers email.

image.takeaway: There is no national US do not email list. The FTC advised Congress against one in June 2004.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on the do not email list: there is no national US do not email registry, the FTC advised Congress against one in June 2004, and Michigan and Utah run child protection registries for adult-category messages.

rows.label: Federal do not email registry found
rows.note: CAN-SPAM section 9 asked the FTC for a plan; the FTC advised against one

Registry models the FTC studied

Utah penalty range per message
rows.note: civil and criminal, as the registry states; felony charges possible
